schema: CREATE TABLE employee_metrics (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, emp_code INTEGER, skill_score INTEGER); CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, emp_code INTEGER, emp_name TEXT); CREATE TABLE departments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, dept_name TEXT); CREATE TABLE projects (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, dept_id INTEGER, lead_emp_code INTEGER, backup_emp_code INTEGER, reviewer_emp_code INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (dept_id) REFERENCES departments(id));
correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT d.dept_name FROM employee_metrics AS em INNER JOIN employees AS e ON em.emp_code = e.emp_code INNER JOIN projects AS p ON e.emp_code = p.backup_emp_code INNER JOIN departments AS d ON p.dept_id = d.id WHERE em.skill_score > 80
